business_problem: Citrix's Globalization Services team was manually reviewing a very large volume of support tickets to identify globalization-related customer requirements, making it difficult to prioritize broad product fixes quickly, measure team effectiveness, and systematically surface product improvement opportunities.
solution_summary: Citrix built an in-house machine learning workflow to analyze the voice of the customer in support tickets and identify issues tied to globalization requirements. The ingest layer is the stream of customer support tickets, plus historical ticket data from 2016 and 2017 that had already been manually reviewed by the Globalization Services team. Citrix cleans the ticket text, removes unhelpful content, and performs feature extraction so each ticket can be represented as numeric vectors. Those vectors feed a decision engine powered by a trained random forest model that classifies whether a ticket is relevant to globalization issues. The classification output is then surfaced through a dashboard used to track accuracy, ticket trends, and team effectiveness. Insights from the model also inform downstream product changes, including a time zone health check tool intended to prevent recurring support issues.

solution_components.name: random forest model

solution_components.name: time zone health check tool
solution_components.role: Applies insights from ticket analysis to help customers identify time zone setting issues.

data_flow: Citrix feeds customer support tickets, including the manually analyzed 2016-2017 corpus, into a preprocessing stage where text is cleaned and converted through feature extraction into numeric vectors. Those vectors are scored by a random forest model inside the decision engine to determine whether a ticket is related to globalization issues. Results are exposed in a dashboard and used to drive product changes such as the time zone health check tool.
business_outcome: The machine learning system lets Citrix analyze support tickets much faster, track trends with a dashboard, better understand globalization-related customer issues, and translate findings into product improvements such as a time zone health check tool. Citrix reports faster large-scale analysis, rising classification accuracy, and an expected reduction in globalization-related support cases.
